# Forbes English

> Interactive English lessons from A1 to C2 — grammar, vocabulary, business English and exam preparation. Each lesson is a 16:9 deck that a teacher can present from or a learner can work through alone: the rule is stated on the slide, then practised, then produced in a speaking and writing task. Many carry a language switcher covering German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Chinese and Japanese; the English being taught stays in English.

Levels follow the CEFR (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2). Lessons marked *subscribers* are behind a subscription — the page describes the lesson and is free to read; the exercises are not.
